headline: Why Is International Paper (IP) Stock Soaring Today
summary: Shares of packaging and materials company International Paper (NYSE:IP) jumped 5% in the morning session after JPMorgan upgraded the stock from Neutral to Overweight and raised its price target to $61 from $51. The analyst firm cited a recent company announcement of a $140 per ton price increase for U.S. kraftliner, a key packaging material, as a reason for the positive outlook. JPMorgan believes this move will significantly improve the company's pricing power and projects a potential 43% upside
